module: Imgui list of a rally notebook's custom audio clips, used in the pacenote editor (custom audio mode). It displays all clips in order, grouped under a header per pacenote (alternating yellow/purple colors, green for the selected pacenote). Each row has a play button, an "anchor" button (crosshair) to choose in the 3D view the pacenote to attach the clip to, a button to clear the anchor, and the transcription text (otherwise the file name). A "Sync audio files" button re-reads the audio folder.
notes: Clips between two anchors are distributed by estimation ("guessed"); an anchor whose order conflicts with another is flagged by a warning in the tooltip.
With no pacenote in the notebook, the clips are listed under "Unassigned audio" and the anchor button is disabled.
A clip whose file does not exist has a red play button.

draw.desc: Draws the toolbar, the anchor pick help and the scrolling clip list. Displays a message if the notebook is missing or no audio file is found.

notebook.desc: Notebook (methods customAudioBasenamesFor, scanCustomAudioBasenames, syncCustomAudioFromDisk, resolveCustomAudioBasename, getCustomAudioAnchorInfo, clearCustomAudioAnchor, loadCustomPacenoteTranscriptions).

selectedPacenote.desc: Currently selected pacenote, whose group is highlighted.

pacenoteToolsWindow.desc: Pacenote tools window: provides beginCustomAudioAnchorPick, isPickingCustomAudioAnchorFor, getCustomAudioAnchorPickBasename.
